data.summary:
Purpose
To ensure that every candidate's resume is evaluated consistently, accurately, and credibly before screening or submission.
This framework combines human judgment and AI-driven rule checks to identify authentic, experienced, and in-depth candidates.
Structure
🟢 Core 9 Categories (Total: 66 Rules) – Mandatory evaluation dimensions for all profiles.
🟡 Optional 3 Categories (Total: 14 Rules) – Contextual checks depending on role, JD, or domain.
Total Rules: 80 (52 Mandatory / 15 Optional / 13 Positive Boosts)
Legend
Symbol Meaning Action ❌ Hard rejection / gating failure Disqualify or probe deeply ⚠️ Cautionary signal Investigate or clarify ✅ Credibility/strength indicator Add to the candidate's confidence score.
🟢 CORE 9 CATEGORIES (66 RULES)
1.

field_details.description: Candidate's full name, extracted from the top header of the resume.
Candidate's residential location or work city.
Candidate's target headline or most recent job title.
Executive bio, professional overview, or career objective.
Technical programming languages and core software competencies.
Software platforms, developer tools, and operational systems.
Functional domain knowledge (e.g. Hedge Funds, KYC, NAV, Derivatives).
Complete list of candidate skills across all categories.
Complete chronological employment records with bullet points.
University, college, and higher education degree qualifications.
Major projects or strategic initiatives led by candidate.

raw_sections.experience:
Executive 
Experience Timeline Integrity (8 Rules)
Validate chronology, stability, and authenticity of employment.
1. ❌ Claimed vs. calculated experience mismatch > 1.5 years.
2. ❌ Overlapping full-time roles (unless dual payroll proof).
3. ❌ Backward or invalid dates (e.g., Feb 2018 – Jan 2017).
4. ❌ Unexplained gaps > 6 months.
5. ⚠️ Multiple short stints (< 12 months each) within one year → possible role inflation.
6. ⚠️ Too-clean transitions (12M/24M/36M) → artificial smoothing.
7. ⚠️ < 1 month gap between education & first job (unless campus placement).
8. ✅ Stable tenure (2–4 years) → credibility boost.
2. Must-Have Skills Depth (7 Rules)
Assess depth, authenticity, and continuity of key technical skills.
1. ❌ Depth < 3 (“applied in project”) on any must-have skill.
2. ❌ Skill only name-dropped (score = 1) with no project context.
3. ⚠️ Used without clarity (score = 2) → probe further.
4. ✅ Depth 3 = Applied in project with context/tools.
5. ✅ Depth 4 = Architected / mentored / optimised (ownership).
6. ✅ At least one must-have skill should reach depth 4 for senior roles (8Y+).
7. ❌ Inconsistent skill claims across roles.
3. Project Ownership & Realism (7 Rules)
Measure real contribution, ownership, and measurable impact.
1. ❌ Missing ownership in ≥ 2 major projects.
2. ❌ No measurable KPIs or outcomes.
3. ❌ No team or scope context (scale, team size).
4. ❌ Inflated ownership (“architected enterprise platform” in 6M role).
5. ⚠️ Overly generic bullets repeated across projects (“responsible for X”).
6. ✅ Clear personal accountability and differentiation from team/company work.
7. ✅ Quantified KPIs (latency ↓40%, throughput ↑3x, cost ↓20%).
4. Language & Tone Realism (8 Rules)
Detect AI-written tone, over-polished phrasing, or vague resumes.
1. ❌ Polished but vague tone with no specifics.
2. ❌ Entirely passive voice across roles.
3. ❌ Obvious GPT-template phrasing (“leveraged synergies”, “orchestrated outcomes”).
4. ⚠️ > 3 vague or buzzword-heavy statements.
5. ⚠️ Repeated phrasing across roles (> 6 times).
6. ❌ Inflated metrics (“95% accuracy” reused).
7. ⚠️ Overused generic verbs (> 10x: “responsible for”, “worked on”).
8. ✅ Balanced tone (mix of technical depth + business outcomes).
5. Credibility & Authenticity Signals (7 Rules)
Ensure employer, education, and role data are verifiable.
1. ❌ Employer vs. client mismatch (vendor claiming client).
2. ❌ > 2 payroll/vendor layers.
3. ❌ Full-time job during full-time education (unless justified).
4. ⚠️ LinkedIn missing or newly created (< 3 months).
5. ⚠️ Fake-sounding email ID.
6. ⚠️ Employer branding contradiction (Tier-3 vendor → FAANG claim).
7. ✅ Clear, verifiable employers and clients.
6. Proxy / Clone Detection (7 Rules)
Identify cloned or AI-generated resumes.
1. ❌ Resume cloned (known template).
2. ❌ Repeated identical achievements across roles.
3. ❌ Cloned + reused KPIs → auto-reject.
4. ⚠️ Resume formatting too uniform.
5. ⚠️ Phrase reuse across projects.
6. ⚠️ AI tone shift mid-resume (half passive, half detailed).
7. ✅ Organic variation in phrasing and project style.
7. Education & Foundational Background (6 Rules)
Validate education credibility and logical career foundation.
1. ❌ Fake or unverifiable institution.
2. ❌ Full-time education overlapping full-time role.
3. ⚠️ < 1 month gap post-education → suspicious unless campus hire.
4. ⚠️ Irrelevant degree (note but not penalize).
5. ✅ Premium institute → credibility boost.
6. ✅ Logical transition (education → entry → progression).
8. Leadership & Career Progression (5 Rules)
Evaluate trajectory, growth, and evidence of leadership.
1. ❌ Flat career over 8+ years.
2. ❌ Repeated lateral roles with no progression story.
3. ✅ Promotion within same company (Engineer → Sr. Engineer → Lead).
4. ✅ Scope growth: mentoring, stakeholder management, design authority.
5. ✅ Leadership activities (hiring, mentoring, tech talks).
9. Pedigree & Macro Signals (6 Rules)
Assess overall employer quality and trajectory.
1. ❌ Repeated downgrade in employer quality.
2. ❌ Job-hopping across Tier-3 vendors.
3. ✅ Employer trajectory improves (Tier-3 → Tier-2 → Tier-1).
4. ✅ Multiple Tier-1 employers → strong signal.
5. ✅ Premium education + Tier-1 experience → high trust.
6. ⚠️ Mixed pedigree → neutral outcome.
🟡 OPTIONAL 3 CATEGORIES (14 RULES)
10. Tools & Certification Validation (6 Rules)
Verify authenticity, relevance, and context of certifications.
1. ❌ Fake or irrelevant certifications.
2. ❌ Laundry list of certifications without project link.
3. ❌ “Pursuing” certification > 6 months old.
4. ⚠️ Tool overload (> 15 tools in short role).
5. ✅ OEM certifications (AWS, GCP, Azure, Oracle) → credibility boost.
6. ✅ Tools clearly tied to project outcomes.
11. JD Alignment & Broadness (3 Rules)
Ensure resume aligns with required and optional JD expectations.
1. ✅ Broad JD → confirm with recruiter whether to cluster or evaluate equally.
2. ❌ Missing must-have skills → auto-reject.
3. ⚠️ JD too generic → mark as “equal weight” evaluation.
12. Domain / Industry Relevance (3 Rules)
Check domain alignment for industry-specific roles.
1. ❌ No domain exposure where mandated (e.g., BFSI).
2. ⚠️ Adjacent domain only (e.g., telecom vs BFSI).
3. ✅ Multiple domain-relevant roles → credibility boost.
🧾 Summary Insights
Strict Rejection Rules (❌)
Experience overclaims, fake education, missing must-have depth, proxy/clone templates, inflated ownership, payroll chains, irrelevant certifications, and pedigree downgrades.
Warning Rules (⚠️)
Vague tone, short stints, tool overload, buzzword overuse, adjacent domains, generic JDs, or unclear depth.
Positive Rules (✅)
Promotion within company, Tier-1 employers, stable tenure, measurable KPIs, depth-4 mastery, premium education, and OEM certifications.
Total Rules: 80
❌ 37 Mandatory Rejects
⚠️ 30 Warnings / Optional Checks
✅ 13 Credibility Boosts
